Re: Dispute of Account ACC-981334

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account with Lakeshore Utilities, our original creditor. You have disputed the debt as already paid. We take all disputes seriously and are investigating this matter.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we must inform you that we will investigate your dispute and verify the accuracy of the debt. We will review our records to determine the current balance of $342.31. We will also confirm the charge-off date of 2023-03-01.

We understand that you have been receiving calls from us regarding this account. We want to assure you that we will not continue to contact you if we determine that the debt has been paid in full. However, we must first investigate and verify the accuracy of the debt.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe it has been paid in full. You may also request validation of the debt, which we have already provided in our initial communication. However, you have indicated that you do not wish to receive validation at this time.

We will conduct a thorough investigation and respond to your dispute in a timely manner. If we determine that the debt has been paid in full, we will take steps to remove the account from our collection efforts.

If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Sincerely,
